### Source corrections only — not #288 acceptance

Head: `21f74e29d9c7e75da04c0410a2fcad717cc2f75f`.
Fixed source base: `795c6d082c8affd213447e0629328fb7ba9d2fe4`.
Delta from `2c10a64ecd3c215c4111fcda1d1b4657d938eaac`: three owned files, +192/-25; normal push, clean worktree, unchanged history.
Draft PR base: `feat/homarr-immich-sol`, `d956824f3758e26bb9cdfc262e229eaf67ef187c`.

- `internal/apps/nextcloud/nextcloud.go`: optional private app-password/token-ID inputs use existing `install --set-file`; explicit paired clearing requires owned-token revocation. Missing ID remains Manual despite working administrator credentials; no name-only adoption. Valid fully recorded credentials/narrower known scopes are reused.
- Recovery requires preserving/reviewing Compose authentication, mounts and ports plus separate replacement approval: reinstall overwrites Compose/generated credential files. Empty inputs cannot erase credentials; no credentials-only ingestion command exists. Unknown corresponding credentials/IDs and 2FA-rejected account-password reissuance remain Manual. Never disable 2FA; default authority remains administrator/broad-write.
- `internal/apps/homarr/target_nextcloud.go`: supported `integration.byId` public username must match the selected account before native queries; password metadata stays redacted, verified against official `v2.4.1`/`ebbd4876d25a51151444a009ab596e1154d62880` source.

Existing `internal/apps/nextcloud/nextcloud_test.go` bodies cover private CLI intake/empty preservation, missing-ID non-adoption, narrower reuse, paired clearing and 2FA/hints. Native identity guard is compiled/source-checked only; no new tests/files/comments/dependencies.

Passed focused/full Go tests, build, both vet gates, TUI/Activity/Nextcloud/Homarr race gates, formatting, installer syntax and diff checks. Registry/common code untouched; no runtime/browser/installer execution. Parent needs BOTH fresh source-review axes before normalization, registration or runtime.

Both fresh independent SOURCE reviews pass with zero findings at 21f74e29d9c7e75da04c0410a2fcad717cc2f75f against fixed actual parent 795c6d082c8affd213447e0629328fb7ba9d2fe4. All three P2s resolved: supported private recovery inputs/clearing with explicit Compose replacement approval, Manual rather than name-only missing-ID adoption, and Homarr saved public username matches canonical selected account before native reads. Explicitly restored ownership is not cryptographic token-ID authentication; broad default authority and reinstall-only recovery remain honestly documented. Reported local gates belong to this source pin. Keep draft: final shared-contract normalization/registration, actual credential issuance/native/rendered and both-order/shared lifecycle acceptance remain unverified; #288 stays open.
